cases.rationale: Root startup preserves access to existing data directories and Docker/Podman host sockets. A fixed nonroot default breaks supported installations; this accepts that explicit privileged deployment boundary, not general root usage.

Root is required for host UID/GID and Docker socket-group setup in run.sh, which then drops to PUSER using su. A fixed nonroot startup identity breaks supported bind-mount setup.
